name: a tilted laptop hero cuts to a photographic site hero
looks: A laptop mockup held at a shallow tilt shows a product site's headline and a soft colour wash; a hard cut takes it to a different site's hero, this one set over a dramatic photograph, with its own headline fading up.
build: ui-tilt-card for the laptop (shallow rotateX/rotateY, soft offset shadow); hard cut (no crossfade) to the second DOM hero card, its headline fading and rising on power2.out.
sound: A soft whoosh as the laptop settles, a hit on the cut.
prompt: Hold a product site in a tilted device mockup with its headline visible, then hard-cut to a second site's hero built over a strong photograph, its own headline fading up a beat after the cut. Use it to show range across two very different brand treatments quickly.
